remarks: Enjoy the best of modern living in this beautifully updated 1-bedroom apartment, ideally located just a short stroll from Wilton Center and scenic Schenck's Island. This sun-filled corner unit features brand new hardwood floors throughout and a fully renovated kitchen with sleek stainless steel appliances and ample storage. Additional highlights include a spacious bathroom, the convenience of in-unit laundry, and access to relax in the pool. Step outside to unwind on the shared terrace, and take advantage of newly paved parking just steps from your door. Nestled in a quiet, well-kept complex, this apartment offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and walkable convenience in the heart of Wilton. Don't miss this opportunity-schedule your showing today!
